subject: Overbilled connector usage on Nov invoice — remediation + VAT evidence
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@everblue.io>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: EverBlue Finance <acct-finance@everblue.io>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Overcharge on Nov invoice — urgent correction and VAT evidence request

Hi David,

We pulled our November statement and noticed a duplicate connector metering line (Invoice INV-2026-11-0387) that resulted in an overcharge of €12,450 plus VAT handling differences. Our procurement/finance team flagged the line as non-representative of actual traffic (the connector flapped during the 11/12 window and was billed twice).

We need Redwood to:
- Confirm the root cause and share the corrected invoice or credit note.
- Advise whether you can either refund the amount or apply it as a credit against future invoices.
- Provide VAT evidence for the reverse-charge (we are based in Ireland; we need the vendor-side VAT certificate or your statement authorizing the reverse-charge).

This is on a tight cycle for our month-end close. Can you confirm by EOB Friday 12/04 a remediation plan and expected timeline for either a refund or credit application?

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement — EverBlue Health
liam@everblue.io

Attachments: referenced invoice (INV-2026-11-0387.pdf)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@everblue.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Overcharge on Nov invoice — urgent correction and VAT evidence request

Hi Liam — thanks for flagging and sorry for the disruption. Looping in our billing and tax teams so we can get this resolved quickly.

Marissa / Kimberly — can you please run an audit on INV-2026-11-0387 (connector metering lines) and advise: whether this is a duplicated charge, the calculation for a corrective credit, and options for refund vs applied credit. Also confirm what VAT evidence we should provide for EverBlue (EU VAT TIN / VAT certificate).

I will follow up with a proposed remediation by EOB tomorrow.

Best,
David
David Kim
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 08:24:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Overcharge on Nov invoice — audit findings and proposal

David / Kimberly,

I completed the ledger walkthrough. Summary:
- Root cause: a short-lived connector re-registration triggered a duplicate metering snapshot between 2026-11-12 02:14–02:19 (same connector id, two ingestion windows). The runtime emitted two usage events; our ingestion dedupe filter failed to coalesce because of a timestamp edge case.
- Impact: duplicate metered tokens on INV-2026-11-0387 totalling €12,450 gross (no separate VAT line on our export; VAT handling depends on customer region).

Remediation options we can offer to the customer:
1) Immediate refund of €12,450 to EverBlue's EUR bank account (requires refund authorization form and up to 10 business days for processing).
2) Apply a one-off credit of €13,200 to be spread across the next three invoices (value includes a 6% goodwill uplift to cover reconciliation effort).

VAT / Tax notes: for EU B2B customers electing reverse-charge, we need a copy of the customer VAT certificate or EU VAT TIN confirmation. Once we have that, we will issue an adjusted invoice/credit note with the correct tax treatment. If they prefer refund, we'll process refund and then issue corrected tax paperwork.

I've attached the billing_audit_nov2026.xlsx (audit worksheet + line-item calc) and a draft credit note text block for David to share.

Recommended next step: present both options to the customer, ask for VAT cert, and request refund authorization only if they prefer the bank refund.

Marissa
Senior Billing Analyst — Redwood Inference

Attachments: billing_audit_nov2026.xlsx
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@everblue.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 13:07:00 +0000
Subject: Proposed remediation for INV-2026-11-0387 (refund or credit)

Hi Liam — thanks again for raising this. Our billing team completed an audit and confirmed there was a duplicated connector metering event. We sincerely apologize for the impact on your month-end close.

We can proceed on one of two paths — please reply with which you prefer and attach EverBlue's VAT certificate if electing reverse-charge handling:

Option A — Immediate bank refund
- Amount: €12,450 gross
- Requirements from EverBlue: signed Refund Authorization (DocuSign link below) + bank details (IBAN/BIC).
- Timing: funds transmitted within 10 business days after authorization is received.

Option B — One-off applied credit (preferred by many customers)
- Credit value: €13,200 applied as a multi-period credit across your next three invoices (effectively covers the error + 6% courtesy uplift).
- Timing: credit will appear on the next billing cycle; we will follow up with an adjusted invoice/credit note.

VAT / EU reverse-charge: please attach your EU VAT certificate or confirm your VAT TIN (e.g., IE1234567E). Once received, we'll issue the corrected tax paperwork and apply the correct reverse-charge notation.

Supporting docs attached: billing_audit_nov2026.xlsx (line-item calc)
DocuSign refund link: https://docusign.example.com/embedded/abcdef
HubSpot ticket: https://hubspot.example.com/contacts/12345 (RBW-4521)

If you prefer, we can process Option B immediately and then update the ledger with the corrected tax treatment once we have the VAT cert.

Best,
David Kim
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: billing_audit_nov2026.xlsx
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@everblue.io>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: EverBlue Finance <acct-finance@everblue.io>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 16:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposed remediation for INV-2026-11-0387 (refund or credit)

Thanks David — appreciate the quick audit and the options. We will take Option B (applied credit across next three invoices).

Attached is our VAT certificate (everblue_vat_certificate_2026.pdf) and our VAT TIN: IE9876543W. No need for a wire — credit is preferable.

Please proceed to:
- Create the credit note and apply it across the next three invoices starting with the January 2027 cycle.
- Confirm once the credit is posted and send the adjusted invoice/credit note (we need this for our internal reconciliations).

On behalf of Finance, we've signed the DocuSign (authorization not needed since we chose credit).

Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement — EverBlue Health
